face.shape: small, slightly elongated oval face with a subtly cat-like overall impression
face.eyes: almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with subtly raised outer corners and a calm, cool, reserved gaze
face.eyebrows: defined dark eyebrows with a clean noticeable shape
face.nose: refined straight nose with a clean bridge
face.lips: small mouth with softly full lips

body.height_impression: tall-looking and long-lined through coordinated relative proportions, never vertical stretching
body.limb_proportions: slim long arms including relatively long forearms, and long straight legs
body.torso: long neck, compact light upper torso, small ribcage appearance, and flat but soft lower abdomen
body.bust: small-to-moderate natural bust, consistent across scenes
body.pelvis_hips: pelvis subtly broader than the East Asian average, with a graceful waist transition and gentle feminine hip roundness, never exaggerated
body.lower_body: long and light lower-body impression with slim thighs and calves and healthy soft-tissue volume
body.body_hair: naturally sparse; dark brown to near-black if visible

stable_dna.hair: near-black long hair reaching around mid-back, straight or softly naturally bent, fine-to-medium strands, smooth controlled shine; default Hair State A is a high ponytail near the crown with soft crown volume, thin face-framing strands, wispy fringe or side-bangs, and partially visible forehead; approved alternatives are long hair down, a slim matte black headband, or a compact updo with a minimal signature U-shaped pin
stable_dna.skin: pale neutral East Asian skin tone with realistic texture and soft highlight roll-off
recognition_anchors: defined dark eyebrows and subtly upturned dark-brown eyes
slim clean jawline and small softly full mouth
small light upper-body impression with long neck and narrow shoulders
narrow waist, subtle pelvis and hip line, and long straight legs
near-black long hair, especially the signature high ponytail

scene_defaults.expression: calm neutral expression or faint restrained smile; never exaggerated by default
scene_defaults.gaze: quiet direct or near-direct shared camera target

hair_states.A: high ponytail tied near the crown with soft crown volume, thin face-framing strands, wispy fringe or side-bangs, and a partially visible forehead
hair_states.B: long straight hair worn down with a center or softly off-center part, controlled natural volume, and no heavy salon waves
hair_states.C: long hair held by a slim matte black headband approximately 1–1.5 cm wide, with the forehead and facial outline clearly visible
hair_states.D: a loose but compact updo secured with one minimal dark tortoiseshell or brushed-silver U-shaped hairpin

sources: GitHub origin/main Harim DNA v0.2 documents
provenance.change_reason: Normalize GitHub Harim DNA v0.2 face, body, hair-state, proportion, and drift-prevention rules into Character Manager schema
